final: WITH m AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS tune FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault), g AS (SELECT tune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM m GROUP BY tune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_kept_count, AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_diff FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt AND a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL
